$comment: Element file schema (lib/schemas) — one file per element at /shared/brand-book/elements/{slug}.json (published) or id:{member_folder_id}/brand-book/elements/{slug}/element.json (draft).
semantic: Prose contract: what this element is for and the design intent, independent of format.

markers.name: actions
markers.description: A NEUTRAL named insertion point the element exposes. The element never names what goes here. A domain template fills it via template.marker_fills; an unfilled marker renders nothing. Reusable across collections.

markdown.instructions: Agent-followable styling instructions for markdown output.

$notes: Absent format key => consumer uses its native default (rendering_missing).
params may reference tokens via {token:...} indirection so palette changes propagate without editing elements.
version is an integer, bumped on every published change.

markers (v1.1+, OPTIONAL): named, behavior-free insertion points the element exposes. Components stay generic; domain-specific templates populate markers via marker_fills. Omit or [] for elements with no insertion points. 'accepts' names the element role expected (an action-control element the org defines).
